subject: Request: Marketplace credit activation & sandbox extension — QuantumLabs pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Mohamed <aisha@quantumlabs.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quantumlabs.io>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension & partner credit request — QuantumLabs sandbox

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. Quick ask: our internal pilot with Redwood is hitting a peak this month and we need an extra 6 weeks to validate the recommender integration (we expect ~1.2M tokens over the extension). Our marketplace listing is still under review and we don’t yet have the voucher flow enabled.

Could Redwood provide partner-sourced promotional credits so we can continue the sandbox without interruption? Ideally $30k of credits (applied to the hosted account or marketplace voucher) that would cover the extension through mid-November. Attached is a draft SOW and our current usage summary.

If you need PO information, Procurement is copied. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the technical details.

Thanks,
Aisha Mohamed
Head of Platform Partnerships
QuantumLabs

Attachments: QuantumLabs-SOW-draft.pdf (pdf), quantum-usage-summary.csv (csv)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Mohamed <aisha@quantumlabs.io>

Date: Thu, 21 Sep 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & partner credit request — QuantumLabs sandbox

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Looping in Ben (SE) and Soojin (Marketplace/Partner Ops) to confirm technical sizing and the best route for vouchers/invoicing.

High level next steps on our side:
- Ben: can you confirm the estimated token burn and whether 30k is sufficient for 6 weeks based on their attached usage?
- Soojin: advise whether we should do a marketplace voucher (recommended for partner-sourced credits) or a direct hosted credit; also call out any compliance/escrow conditions.
- Procurement: if a PO is required for SOW execution, please share the PO# and billing contact — we can provision credits conditionally until marketplace flow is active.

I can provision a provisional approval once we confirm the numbers and voucher flow; aim to get this locked by next Tue (26 Sep) so their engineers don’t hit rate limits.

—Lauren Bishop
Sr. Strategic Account Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & partner credit request — QuantumLabs sandbox

Lauren / Aisha — I pulled their usage CSV and ran a quick projection.

Summary:
- Current weekly token consumption (avg): ~200k tokens/week (mix of long-form generation + embeddings).
- Peak weeks have hit ~360k tokens.
- With expected ramp from feature tests, 6-week projection is ~1.1–1.4M tokens.
- At their current model profile (redwood-open-3b quantized), $/k-token effective ~ $22 per 100k tokens on hosted plan.

Recommendation: $28k–$32k credit band to be safe; I lean toward $30k conditional on voucher path. If we provision hosted credits instead of marketplace voucher, we should gate by SOW sign-off and PO to avoid misuse.

Attached: quantum-usage-summary.csv (sanitized)

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Pilot extension & partner credit request — QuantumLabs sandbox

Quick ops note — marketplace voucher is cleaner for partner-funded promos because:
- It preserves clear attribution to the partner (QuantumLabs) in our billing/analytics.
- Voucher redemptions can be timeboxed and capped automatically (we can set expiration + token cap).
- For compliance: we require a signed SOW with usage covenant (one-pager appended) and the partner to accept voucher terms.

If voucher flow will not be ready by the time they need the extension, we can provide provisional hosted credits but will require a PO and a short credit agreement (approval memo). If hosted credits, ops will place a hold on scaling rules and enable additional throttles to avoid accidental spikes.

Action items for QuantumLabs:
- Sign the attached SOW and return to docusign link (I’ve included a placeholder).
- Confirm whether they prefer voucher redemptions or hosted credit.
- Procurement: PO or billing contact for conditional hosted credit issuance.

I recommend voucher + $30k cap, expiry 2028-11-15, unless Procurement needs hosted invoicing.

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Hi Aisha — good news. After internal alignment: Redwood can provision a partner-sourced marketplace voucher for QuantumLabs with a $30,000 redemption cap, valid through 2028-11-15. This is contingent on: 1) signed SOW (DocuSign link below), and 2) marketplace voucher redemption tied to the QuantumLabs marketplace listing (so attribution is preserved).

If the marketplace voucher cannot be redeemed before they need the extension, we can temporarily place $30k of hosted credits on their account on the condition of an issued PO and signed SOW; hosted credits will be reclaimed if the voucher is later redeemed.

Next steps:
- Aisha / Procurement: please sign the SOW here: https://docusign.com/placeholder-sign/QNL-SOW-2028 and confirm voucher redemption timeline.
- Soojin / Ops: please provision the voucher entry and set cap/expiry as noted; Ben please confirm rate-limits/auto-throttles are enabled for that account.
- I'll update the HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/QNL-2028-01 and mark as "Credit Provisioning - Partner Voucher" with expected close 2028-09-28.

Attaching an approval note for records: lauren-credit-approval-note.txt

Thanks everyone — aiming to have the voucher available before the end of day Thursday if all signed.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
